title: Hunter v1.15.0
reason: .github/workflows/release.yml reacts to the v* tag push: it validates the tag against VERSION, runs scripts/release.sh to build hunter:v1.15.0 and package dist/hunter-v1.15.0.tar.gz, generates the release body with scripts/release-notes.py (SHA-256 computed from the built archive), and creates the GitHub Release with that single asset. No local asset build or notes file is needed.
